title: ResearchOS Search Log Entry
description: One search actually executed, so that 'we found nothing' can be distinguished from 'we did not look'. Written by the search step (S1) of the hypothesis cycle; a new source must point back at one of these records via source.query_id. A model cannot run this step from a script in this environment -- export.arxiv.org is not reachable from the sandbox -- so the record is written by the agent session that performed the fetch. See docs/2026-10-21_hypothesis-cycle-automation.md section 3 (S1).

channel.description: keyword = full-text/abstract search; citation = forward or backward citation walk; review = survey/review article; known_item = a specific paper fetched by identifier (added 2026-10-21 in round 1: looking up a paper already known by arXiv ID is not a keyword search and was previously only expressible as 'manual'); manual = a human supplied the item (still recorded, so the route is visible).

api.description: tool or endpoint used, e.g. 'arxiv abs page via web fetch'

derived_from.description: Ledger IDs (EVD/HYP/REL) whose gap produced this query. A query with no such link is an unplanned search; that is allowed but reported by the planner.
